character: Fast, flat, flowing former airfield circuit in Norfolk. High-speed corners dominate — momentum and smooth inputs matter more than heavy braking.

corners.name: Riches
corners.technique: Commit with smooth steering, carry maximum speed through the long radius
corners.trap: Lifting mid-corner kills momentum through this key speed section

corners.name: Wilson
corners.technique: Late apex, patient throttle application on exit
corners.trap: Early throttle causes a slide on the tightening exit

corners.name: Coram
corners.technique: Commit through the long radius with smooth, minimal steering correction
corners.trap: Any correction at speed here scrubs significant time

corners.name: Palmer
corners.type: final corner onto the pit straight
corners.technique: Late apex, clean exit is critical — feeds the run to the line
corners.trap: Poor exit here costs time down the entire straight
